messages:
elaine: FYI we're scheduling the v1 -> v2 API alias removal for next Tue 09:00 PST. Need a quick audit of docs redirects + any SDK snippet changes that reference the old /v1/paths :wave

sam: ack. I'll preflight a redirect map PR and a smoke test harness for the examples. which endpoints are highest priority?

elaine: priority list: 1) /v1/chat -> /v2/chat 2) embed model alias 'embed-legacy' -> 'embed-1' 3) auth param rename (api_key -> token) in examples. Also any code samples that construct clients using the old Client() signature.

miguel: tagging SDK owners — some TS snippets use the old positional args, will update to named opts. I can do the TS changes but need the PR checklist for backports to older doc branches.

katie: I'm on redirects. I have a draft redirect JSON for the docs site. Quick sanity check?

katie: ```json
{
  "redirects": [
    {"from": "/v1/chat", "to": "/v2/chat", "status": 301},
    {"from": "/models/embed-legacy", "to": "/models/embed-1", "status": 302}
  ]
}
```

sam: looks good. For the embed dim change, we should add a note in the migration guide: customers may need to reindex vectors if dim changes. I'll add a short paragraph and a CLI snippet to re-embed.

ajay: I'll take ownership of the CLI snippet. Proposed command: ```bash
redwood-cli reembed --src=old-index --model=embed-1 --batch=200
```

miguel: Docs-bot can publish a deprecation banner once we have the PRs linked. @docs-bot any automation for inserting the banner and scheduling the site announcement?

docs-bot: :robot_face: I can add the banner when the redirect PR is merged and the "deprecations.json" file is updated. Please create a deprecations entry with: date, affected_endpoints, owner. Example format: `v1-sunset: {date: "2026-04-07", owners: ["elaine","sam"]}`

elaine: putting the anchor in: deprecation entry will be created in docs/deprecations/v1-sunset.md and linked from the top-level announcement. Can someone add the note about graceful fallback policies — i.e., model alias fallback to a cheaper quantized variant?

sam: I'll add the fallback paragraph and a sample policy block. Quick draft: ```yaml
fallbacks:
  - alias: embed-legacy
    fallback_to: embed-1-quantized
    when: capacity_constrained
```

katie: PR plan: 1) redirect JSON PR (docs) 2) migration guide updates with reindexing steps and param rename 3) SDK snippet updates for TS/Python 4) deprecations entry 5) merge + banner. Assign reviewers on each.

miguel: For SDK PRs, please target both main and the stable-2025 branch. Mark changelog entries with the breaking change header and include quick replacement snippets.

elaine: Ownership: sam -> migration guide + reindex CLI, katie -> redirects + deprecations entry, miguel -> TS snippets + backport, ajay -> Python snippets + smoke tests. I'll review and schedule the docs announcement after merges.

sam: small callout: some internal examples in the partner integration repo reference api_key. I'll open a follow-up ticket to sweep repos for hardcoded param names.

katie: one blocker: a third-party snippet in the tutorials uses old embed dims and assumptions about cosine similarity scaling. I'll add a note and a small snippet to normalize vectors post-reembed.

ajay: test plan for smoke tests: create a tiny harness that runs key examples against a staging v2 endpoint and verifies status 200 and output shape. I'll attach results to each PR.

miguel: FYI I'll update the snippet lint action to flag any usage of "/v1/" or "embed-legacy" so future PRs fail CI until updated.

elaine: perfect. timeline: have PRs up EOD Fri, merge early Mon, site banner Tue at 09:00 PST. If anyone can't meet an owner slot, say now.

sam: on it, aiming to open the migration guide PR in the next 3 hours.

katie: opening redirect PR now, will add reviewers.

miguel: will start TS changes, expect PR by EOD.

ajay: smoke tests script on my fork, sharing link in PR body.

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: Reminder scheduled: deprecation-announcement -> 2026-04-07T09:00:00-08:00. Will post when `deprecations/v1-sunset.md` is merged.

elaine: thanks team — trying to keep this low-friction. If you find surprising edge-cases (sdk behavior changes, param collisions), drop them here and we'll triage. :pray
